scoring_method.method: Weighted mean of available dimensions; weights are renormalized over available dimensions. Missing dimensions are excluded, not assigned zero.
scoring_method.important_note: Final Quality Score is a baseline indicator based on mapped upstream signals, not a probability, investment recommendation, or guarantee.

confidence.meaning: Dukungan terhadap scoring saat ini; bukan data-quality score atau probabilitas.

data_quality.score_policy: No new 0-100 data-quality score is introduced in Stage 6M; numeric calibration requires an empirically validated model.
data_quality.phase_coverage_semantics: Phase presence means artifact availability only; it is not equivalent to COMPLETE data coverage.

wallet_history.selection_quality: Selection completeness is reported separately from history completeness.

evidence_quality.note: Evidence strength is evidence support quality, not final data-quality confidence and not probability.

current_scoring_support_confidence.note: This metric describes support for the current scoring output. It is not a standalone data-quality score, probability, or token-quality guarantee.

score_explainability.denominator_policy: Only available dimensions are included; unavailable dimensions are excluded, not assigned zero.
